Barbie & Her Sisters - Puppy Rescue.name: Barbie and Her Sisters: Puppy Rescue
Barbie & Her Sisters - Puppy Rescue.summary: Players will join Barbie and her sisters as they work together to rescue and train lost puppies in Barbie and Her Sisters: Puppy Rescue. The game is set in Barbie’s hometown Willows, and inspired by the home movie Barbie and her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure.

Boulder Dash-XL 3D.name: Boulder Dash-XL 3D
Boulder Dash-XL 3D.summary:
In this the sequel to the 1984 classic action-puzzler, players set forth as Rockford or Crystal and mine their way through a variety of hazardous, yet stunning, three dimensional caves while avoiding crushing boulders and an eerie menagerie of killer creatures.
Features:
- Dazzling 3D Graphics glisten on Nintendo 3DS
- 4 Varied Gaming Worlds (Ice, Ancient, Reactor, Space)
- 5 Game Modes (Arcade, Puzzle, Zen, Score Attack and Retro)
- Over 150 All New and Exciting Caves to Conquer
- New Scoring mechanics provide an exciting challenge for high score hunters.
- Share unlocks and high score with your friends via StreetPass

LEGO Pelicula el Videojuego, La.name: The LEGO Movie Video Game
LEGO Pelicula el Videojuego, La.summary: The 3DS, Vita and Mobile versions of The LEGO Movie Video Game features utterly different level layouts and gameplay to the main version of the game, such as a system where you go back to the last checkpoint and losing progress when you respawn instead of respawning on the spot.
